logic_errors.impact: The probe cannot substantiate a universal claim that its controls array is the current rendered/enabled hitbox set. verify_phase4_player.py:117-119 treats this array as native-reachable authority; an already-satisfied postcondition can accept a stale/no-op target. Current recorded generation, reveals, inspection indices, retries, save hashes and final PNGs remain valid independently.
logic_errors.not_a_product_defect: The real modal renderer/host gates competing commands (BinderPresentation.cs:129-141, Phase4CollectionHost.cs:109-113). The actual screenshot has disabled Cancel and no visible competing collection controls. Ghost enabled entries are an observation defect, not proof production allows those actions.
logic_errors.required_resolution: Before unqualified probe/harness approval, use a coherent current-render control snapshot rather than historical union, or explicitly qualify/exclude stale-control evidence and obtain independent current-control proof. Any code correction needs new exact pins and applicable rebuilt-player evidence; this review makes no source fix.

logic_errors.finding: The final audit verifies compiler count and source-subset hashes, but never validates compiler extras or re-runs verify_compiled_inputs. It republishes build[compiledClosure] without deriving it from the compiler map it just loaded.
logic_errors.reproduction: Offline AST extraction/execution of the exact line-27 guard against real source/compiler dictionaries plus synthetic in-memory Assets/Unexpected.cs and incremented fileCount accepts a compiler map of 178 entries. No artifact was changed and the operational main was not invoked.
logic_errors.impact: The audit itself would not refuse an added non-folder script even though its stated compiler-closure contract permits only generated folder metas. This is a logic defect in the acceptance checker, not a discovered unexpected script in the actual build.
logic_errors.actual_snapshot: Independent complete map comparison proves the actual compiler has exactly 177 entries: every one of 176 delivered source hashes plus only Assets/VintageCollector/Collections.meta. The extra exists as a real folder meta with expected SHA256/GUID. No actual candidate/compiler discrepancy was found.
logic_errors.required_resolution: Derive/check compiler extras and closure rather than trusting the prior summary before calling this audit a standalone fail-closed acceptance gate; alternatively explicitly retain the independent closure check as an additional required gate. No code was changed.

evidence_gaps_and_nonblocking_notes.note: Primary fixture has a <=256-byte pre-read size check and exact decoded-text contract, but arm-fault.txt has no size cap before File.ReadAllText. Primary FileInfo.Length then ReadAllText is also not a hard same-handle read bound; ReadAllText accepts a BOM rather than enforcing byte identity. Only the explicitly opted-in local owned fixture path is exposed; no normal-startup/untrusted-network path or oversized actual fixture was observed. Do not describe every probe input as bounded/exact raw bytes.

renderedLabels is a lifetime cumulative set; presence does not prove a label was drawn in the current frame or at every card. physicalLabels is a current computed projection, not raster proof. Independent inspection of actual native-072.png and per-card persisted ownership comparison supports the final-frame badge claim; report predicates alone do not.

PNG validator checks CRC/chunks/decompression and nonempty data, but not decompressed row-size/filter validity. Independent review additionally checked exact RGB/RGBA8 decompressed scanline sizes and filter bytes on all 275 actual retained PNGs; all valid.

141 accepted captures means 141 distinct paths, not 141 distinct image contents. Accepted framebuffers have 107 distinct SHA256 contents; service11=>10 unique contents, input03 130=>97, repeat134=>102. Repeated captures of unchanged/transition UI are legitimate and do not add unique tests.

Atomic native tests exercise temporary sharing lock, persistent bounded refusal/prior-byte preservation, and recovery. Non-sharing error propagation is established by direct source branch review, not a separate fourth native regression. Retry permits only low Windows error32/33, at most100 sleeps of10ms/101 publication attempts; file-write errors occur outside retry, and unrelated IOException or non-IOException is not masked.

Frame/state publication samples Snapshot after framebuffer completion, and labels are cumulative. This is not an atomic timestamped raster/state pairing or independent OS forensic process attestation. Distinct retained commands, report files, native Direct3D logs, native exit assertions and runner source support the two-process-per-case provenance.
